prior_verdict_comparison_rows.addressed_by: V605 emits exactly the 12 documented tasks, checks the real next-roadmap file, keeps the contract advisory, and verifies gate-field declarations and an ungated capstone.
This attempt performs no acquisition and writes a fresh reducer receipt whose process wall time and source live time have independent derivations while the original TAUTOLOGY flag stays immutable.
This attempt consumes the new alias-safe receipt, limits scope to source and tuple checks, never opens the ASP sidecar, and uses a bounded replay instead of the prior monolithic reducer.
This attempt consumes the new alias-safe receipt, isolates ASP and isomorphic checks in one bounded shard, and uses two exact engines instead of the prior monolithic task.
This attempt only merges two bounded, independently replayed shards from the alias-safe source and requires one-to-one row joins before it produces an event bank.
This attempt starts from the new two-shard qualified event bank and adds isomorphic restructuring plus explicit valid-alternative support before any learning arm runs.
This stream starts from independently qualified model-produced relations instead of the parse-failed Exp5708 source.
This attempt requires a clean model-qualified bank, source-group splits, exact isomorphic transforms, and sealed future outcomes before learning.
This attempt receives the new isomorphic qualified stream and adds future-trainability support as a promotion gate while preserving matched read-only and update arms.
This attempt uses model-qualified typed relations, structural keys, isomorphic shifts, asymmetric exact costs, and a bounded update compared directly with the same commissioned read-only memory.
This audit consumes a completed new relation-memory protocol, replays isomorphic transfer and future support, and gates on completion rather than the learner utility score.
This audit uses a new exact-qualified relation stream and measures future trainability and isomorphic support in addition to the earlier safety and utility checks.
This attempt is an ungated relation-prefix fixture with two directly available exact engines; it does not depend on the missing Exp6689 planning-fixture artifact that blocked the prior audit.
This attempt uses unconstrained plain relation lines, candidate-level exact extendability, equal sample budgets, and a separate exact final evaluator; it uses no schema decode or repair reprompt.
prior_verdict_comparison_rows.prior_verdict: retired: schema-supported ConstraintIR decoding failed exact-semantic retirement gates

prior_verdict_comparison_rows.addressed_by: This attempt changes the intervention from structured prompting to in-search exact prefix rejection and compares against matched unguided best-of-k on dynamic held tasks.
prior_verdict_comparison_rows.prior_verdict: complete_null: structured prompt arms did not improve exact synthesis

prior_verdict_comparison_rows.addressed_by: This attempt discovers fresh receipts dynamically, measures banked level transitions and actions-to-progress, and removes the prior hard-coded Exp6681 source and transient-progress credit.
This attempt is an ungated ARC root that reads canonical live receipts directly, preserves flagged router history, and does not depend on the retired Exp6857 headroom score.
V605 uses an ungated 12-task state matrix, replays every present artifact, distinguishes structured skips from missing work, and carries three independent science roots plus exact retirement actions.
